properties.description:
Access from: Front St W

The Bicycle Station is located on the east side of York Street, just south of Front Street. The facility features [approximately 160] bike racks, a washroom, a change room and  a shower with complimentary towels, and an office where staff can register new members and renew bike station parking plans. Tools and pumps are available for members to perform minor repairs.
